key_discoveries.title: Inspection Document Requirements & Lesson Observation Criteria
key_discoveries.details: ART.30 OMEC 6106/2020 criteria for lesson observation: student-centered strategies, differentiation, interdisciplinarity, digital resources, feedback, creativity. key_discoveries.title: Complete Inspection Dossier - Grade VIII Arrays Lesson
key_discoveries.details: Full lesson project, worksheets, test for Grade VIII theme 'Siruri' (Arrays). Resources: lesson plans, student worksheets, assessment rubric. Files stored in C:\AI\Vault with structured navigation (HOME.md, Inspectie/, Schools/, Teaching/).

key_discoveries.title: Pedagogical Research - PBL in EFL Classes
key_discoveries.details: Research project structure: Experimental hypothesis (PBL improves linguistic competencies + motivation), objectives (theory, PBL design, competency evaluation, motivation measurement, methodological recommendations), methodology (experimental group + control group, pre/post testing, questionnaires, product analysis)
key_discoveries.relevance: Models advanced assessment approaches: experimental design, competency evaluation frameworks, motivation measurement tools

key_discoveries.title: LearningHub Technical Analysis - Student Submission System
key_discoveries.details: Current state: Static site without backend. Student limitations & solutions: 1) Python Flask/FastAPI backend, 2) Firebase Storage, 3) Supabase, 4) Google Drive API. Existing components: user-system.js (profiles), lesson-summary.js (JSON export SHA-256), evaluate_submissions.py (validation). Missing: server-side storage + upload endpoint.
key_discoveries.relevance: Implementation roadmap for student feedback collection in LearningHub refactoring
